title: The artifact door refuses an append that drops what a record already held
intention: cairn/tools/artifact write()/write_json() given verb 'append' on a .json record refuses, writing nothing, unless the record's current JSON value is a list and the new value is a list that begins with every current element unchanged and in order (or the record does not exist yet); the refusal names the first index that differs or is missing.
why: Akien 2026-10-10: "to the best of your ability, get it all closed", pre-approved through PROVED. This ticket closes live trouble /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/troubles/a-history-truncation-passes-the-door-and-the-commit.json, a measured fault that enters as a bug (skills/intent/SKILL.md: a bug enters as a ticket, not through /intent). 9528475c replaced cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/history.json (29 entries) with one entry; the artifact door journaled it as verb append and the pre-commit hook passed. The build_inspector history_integrity sieve (inspector.py:2963) would red it but is not run at commit.
traces_to: Law 7 (a record of truth is permanent); Law 4 (the in-place-edit rule enforced at the door every write passes, not only by an inspector the commit does not run).
how: cairn/tools/artifact/artifact.py only: in write(), after the canonical check for '.json' and only when verb == 'append': old = json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else None; new = json.loads(blob); refuse (Refused) unless old is None or (isinstance(old, list) and isinstance(new, list) and new[:len(old)] == old). Name the first bad index. Build after 9df0f230a087 and 1fc53d5d96cc (same function).
falsifier: cairn/tools/artifact/proofs/test_an_append_keeps_what_was_there.py under PROVES {'a742af217819': {'1','2','3'}} on a tmp root: (1) append of old+[x] lands and journals; (2) append of [x] over a 3-entry list, append that edits entry 1, and append over a dict are each refused naming the index/shape, file and journal unchanged; (3) the same truncating body with verb 'cast' is not judged by this rule. Hollow: deleting the prefix check reds 2.

intent_berth: none, because this is a bug entering as a ticket (skills/intent/SKILL.md, the TICKET entry point), born from the measured fault at /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/troubles/a-history-truncation-passes-the-door-and-the-commit.json

decisions.text: Judge only verb 'append': the verb is the writer's own claim, and the door holds it to it. A rewrite that means to shrink must say 'cast' and carry its why in the journal. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
